{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Replace sentinel values (-999.0) with NaN
sentinel_value = -999.0
trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(sentinel_value, pd.NA)

# Convert to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] = pd.to_numeric(trial_df['biomarker_baseline'], errors='coerce')

# Calculate mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean(numeric_only=True)

# Print the result
mean_baseline"}
